caption: The drawing shows a single mug or pitcher placed centrally on a plain background. The body of the vessel is cylindrical with a slightly flared upper edge and a small spout on the rim. The exterior of the mug is a deep, glossy blue, while the interior is a pale blue or light turquoise color. The handle is large, rounded, and depicted in shades of gray and white, suggesting it is made from a reflective material such as metal or glass. The vessel sits on a circular base, which is colored in similar gray and white tones as the handle, indicating a matching material. The background is a uniform beige or off-white color with some light stains or discoloration, and no other objects or details are present in the composition. The drawing uses strong contrast and highlights to give the vessel a three-dimensional appearance.
